title: Countries played and recorded in
summary: He reads off the countries he has played, from Austria to Argentina, recording in almost all of them.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You couldn't do it here - nobody was interested. But, over there, they were. And, so, now as I go along on these five years scene and I'm staying and I wanted to stay more and more and the longer I stayed the more work I got; I actually got to the point in Europe where I was turning down jobs; I didn't want to work that hard. And, when I go--- I don't think there was a country hardly that I played that I didn't record in and you want me to tell you - to just give you a rough idea of how many countries I've played -- I'll just read them off here for you -- I played in Austria, Belgium, Czechoslovakia, Denmark, England, France, Germany, Holland, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Monte Carlo, Norway, Poland, Scotland, Sweden, Switzerland and I went down to Buenos Aires - last year - Argentina. So, almost every one of those countries I recorded in and some I recorded twice - like in Poland and some of those places. And, in Denmark, I must have made fifteen (15) long playing albums with different groups - you know---
